explanation: The agent incorrectly listed orders for customer C-031 instead of the intended customer C-019. This led to a mismatch in the expected latest order and the shipment status, as the order referenced was not associated with the correct customer.
counterfactual: Ask which customer the user means (the request names a city) and continue with the matching record.
recommendation: Require a clarifying question when a lookup returns more than one match.
